note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1939: contests in five divisions. The members returned unopposed or deemed re-elected in the other 23 divisions are not named in the reports read. Polled 25 May 1939. A tie at 129 votes each: both names were drawn from a hat and Morris was declared the winner. M'Ardle was the outgoing member.
